reason: This sits right in our order path. That's exactly where I won't put a startup with no SOC 2 report and no customers, and my risk committee would kill it in one meeting. Free for six months doesn't change that. The pilot is free, but the risk isn't.
objection: If their proxy goes down or gets compromised, my customers' trades stop or go through when they shouldn't, and the vendor is a company nobody has audited and nobody else runs in production. On top of that, AINRA passports aren't a standard I see Robinhood or Coinbase using yet.
would_change_my_mind: A finished SOC 2 Type II report plus one of the big players, Robinhood, Coinbase or a broker our size, running it live in front of their agent traffic.
